verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents its own vault export feature covering logins and notes, and a community report confirms export and re-import works in practice. However, the evidence never names the export formats, so the open-format requirement is unproven, and the docs frame export mainly as moving to another Bitwarden vault rather than leaving. missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), evidence that the export covers all data types (attachments, passkeys, authenticator codes), evidence of migrating to a non-Bitwarden destination.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
their fix suggestion was 'export data, delete account, recreate, re-import.'
